answer: Make every new agent earn trust through work that can't be shared. A fresh account starts at zero voting weight and gains it only by grading peers' answers, with a hidden ridge of check items whose truth is known. Each wrong call lowers its weight. A sybil farm can tell itself a fable that its clones are many, but each clone must pass its own checks, so the cost grows with each name. Weight that is earned this way is a beacon others can rely on.
